newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates DSL Bank, L-bank and Helaba new issues.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates DSL Bank, L-bank and Helaba new issues.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Friday it had assigned a AAA rating to new five-year note issues from DSL Finance NV, Helaba International Finance Plc, Dublin and Baden-Wuerttemberg L-Finance NV.
DSL Finance NV's has issued 250 million mark 5.0 percent notes due 2002, guaranteed by Deutsche Siedlungs-und Landesrentenbank (DSL Bank).
"The rating is based on the implied federal German guarantee for the obligations of DSL Bank," IBCA said in a statement.
Helaba International Finance Plc, Dublin has issued $500 million 6.875 percent notes due 2002, guaranteed by Landesbank Hessen-Thueringen Girozentrale.
Baden-Wuerttemberg L-Finance NV has issued $500 million 7.0 percent notes due 2002, guaranteed by Landeskreditbank Baden-Wuerttemberg (L-Bank).
"The rating is based on the implied federal German guarantee for the obligations of L-bank," IBCA said.
